feature_title: Antigravity Environment Scaffolder & Knowledge Setup CLI

zero_trust_path_boundary_confinement.details: All generated scaffold file paths strictly validated against target workspace root via ValidatePathBoundary.

posix_permission_isolation.details: 0755 permissions strictly applied to scripts/graphify_sync.sh; 0644 applied to markdown rules, workflows, and manifests.

two_phase_atomic_staging.details: All disk writes staged to .tmp buffers before atomic os.Rename commits, preventing partial or corrupted file writes.

non_destructive_merging.details: Existing .gitignore and AGENTS.md files preserved with idempotent marker searches before appending.

memory_and_cgo_safety.details: Pure Go 1.26+ standard library implementation; zero CGo, zero unsafe.Pointer, zero third-party dependencies.

deterministic_race_detection.details: 34 table-driven tests executed with go test -v -race with 0 data races and 91.8% statement coverage on internal/scaffold.
